note: general customs of the Hu peoples (region note); cremation and animal sacrifice for the dead

note: eat the three pure kinds of meat (食雜三淨)

國東境城北天祠前，有大龍池
note: Mizutani: this 天祠 is probably a fire-temple (拝火教), not an Indian Maheśvara shrine; city now deserted

note: Buddha footprint stone; 90-ft standing images at the west gate; quinquennial assembly; processional images

note: legend of the king's brother (self-castration); monastery founded to commemorate it

龍魚雜處，靈怪間起，所以往來行旅，禱以祈福
note: travellers pray at Issyk-kul for blessings

settlement of Chinese captives

quote: 諸僧徒以十二月十六日入安居，三月十五日解安居
note: Tukhāra region note: monks keep the rain retreat 12/16-3/15 because of the rains; no counts or school

伽藍二所，僧徒百餘人

note: king a Xisu (奚素) Turk

伽藍十餘所，僧徒五百餘人
伽藍百有餘所，僧徒三千餘人，並皆習學小乘法教
note: capital called "Little Rājagṛha" (小王舍城)

quote: 納縛僧伽藍…有佛澡罐…又有佛牙…又有佛掃箒…今僧徒百餘人
note: Nava-saṃghārāma: Vaiśravaṇa image, Buddha's bathing pot, tooth and broom; 200-ft stupa; hundreds of arhat stupas

quote: 城中各有一窣堵波…斯則釋迦法中最初窣堵波也…迦葉波佛時之所建也
note: stupas of Trapuṣa and Bhallika (hair and nail relics); stupa of Kāśyapa Buddha's time

quote: 伽藍十餘所，僧徒三百餘人，並學小乘教說一切有部
note: Beal's text: 200 monks

quote: 淳信之心，特甚隣國。上自三寶，下至百神…伽藍數十所，僧徒數千人，宗學小乘說出世部
note: 說出世部 = Lokottaravādin, a Mahāsāṃghika branch (Mizutani)

quote: 有立佛石像，高百四五十尺…東有伽藍，此國先王之所建也
note: the larger Bāmiyān standing Buddha

quote: 伽藍東有鍮石釋迦佛立像，高百餘尺
伽藍中有佛入涅槃臥像，長千餘尺。其王每此設無遮大會
note: king gives himself away at the unrestricted assembly

quote: 有僧伽藍，中有佛齒及劫初時獨覺齒
note: teeth of Buddha, pratyekabuddha, cakravartin; Śāṇakavāsa's bowl and robe

quote: 伽藍百餘所，僧徒六千餘人，並多習學大乘法教…天祠數十所，異道千餘人，或露形，或塗灰，連絡髑髏
note: 露形 = Digambara Jains; 塗灰 = Pāśupata; skull-garland wearers are Śiva devotees (Mizutani). King reveres the Three Jewels

quote: 有大伽藍，僧徒三百餘人，並學小乘法教…有觀自在菩薩像
note: hostage monastery (summer residence); Avalokiteśvara image on the ridge

quote: 至曷邏怙羅僧伽藍，傍有窣堵波
note: minister Rāhula's stupa with relics

quote: 至霫蔽多伐剌祠城
note: Watters (followed tentatively by Mizutani) reads 祠 as "temple": town with a temple of Śvetavat = Indra

quote: 初，䅳那天神自遠而至，欲止此山
note: Mizutani: 䅳那 (Śunā/Zhuna) probably a god of vegetation

quote: 王即為龍於雪山下立僧伽藍，建窣堵波…窣堵波中有如來骨肉舍利
note: Kaniṣka and the nāga legend

quote: 舊王伽藍內，有釋迦菩薩弱齡齠齓…有如來頂骨一片…有舊王妃伽藍，中有金銅窣堵波
note: king and ministers make offerings on the six fast days

quote: 無憂王即盤石上起窣堵波…後人於此建立伽藍，名鞞鐸佉
note: Aśoka stupa of Pīlusāra
